name: facebookresearch_meshrcnn/meshrcnn/utils/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_meshrcnn/meshrcnn/utils.compute_ap: compute average precision from detection scores and labels using the VOC evaluation protocol
facebookresearch_meshrcnn/meshrcnn/utils.xVOCap: calculate VOC-style average precision from recall and precision curves using interpolation
facebookresearch_meshrcnn/meshrcnn/utils.test_compute_ap: test the compute_ap function with sample PyTorch tensors for scores and binary labels
facebookresearch_meshrcnn/meshrcnn/utils.test_xVOCap: test the xVOCap function with recall and precision tensors to verify AP calculation
facebookresearch_meshrcnn/meshrcnn/utils.refactor_compute_ap: refactor compute_ap to support batched input tensors for parallel AP computation

facebookresearch_meshrcnn/meshrcnn/utils.compare_meshes_chamfer: compute chamfer distance and evaluation metrics between predicted and ground truth 3D meshes
facebookresearch_meshrcnn/meshrcnn/utils.compare_meshes_precision_recall: compute precision, recall, and F1 scores at various distance thresholds for mesh comparison
facebookresearch_meshrcnn/meshrcnn/utils.compare_meshes_normal_consistency: compute normal consistency and absolute normal consistency between predicted and ground truth meshes
facebookresearch_meshrcnn/meshrcnn/utils.scale_meshes_for_comparison: scale predicted and ground truth meshes using a uniform scalar or bounding box normalization
facebookresearch_meshrcnn/meshrcnn/utils.sample_meshes_surface_points: sample uniform points and normals from mesh surfaces or use vertex positions as samples

facebookresearch_meshrcnn/meshrcnn/utils.build_projective_transform_identity: build a ProjectiveTransform with a default identity 3x3 matrix for batched coordinate transformations
facebookresearch_meshrcnn/meshrcnn/utils.apply_forward_transform: apply a forward projective transformation to batched 2D coordinates using the ProjectiveTransform callable
facebookresearch_meshrcnn/meshrcnn/utils.apply_inverse_transform: apply the inverse projective transformation to batched 2D coordinates using the inverse method
facebookresearch_meshrcnn/meshrcnn/utils.estimate_transform_matrix_svd: estimate a projective transformation matrix from source to destination coordinates using SVD method
facebookresearch_meshrcnn/meshrcnn/utils.center_and_normalize_points: center and normalize batched 2D points for improved numerical stability in transformation estimation

facebookresearch_meshrcnn/meshrcnn/utils.transform_verts_with_rotation_and_transl: transform 3D vertices using a rotation matrix and translation vector
facebookresearch_meshrcnn/meshrcnn/utils.read_voxel_from_matlab_file: read a voxel grid from a MATLAB file and return centered normalized vertices
facebookresearch_meshrcnn/meshrcnn/utils.convert_2d_boxes_to_3d_cuboids: convert 2D bounding boxes with depth ranges into 3D cuboid coordinates
facebookresearch_meshrcnn/meshrcnn/utils.estimate_projective_transforms_from_cubo: estimate projective transforms for xz and yz planes from a 3D cuboid tensor
facebookresearch_meshrcnn/meshrcnn/utils.review_transform_verts_function: review the transform_verts function to understand rotation and translation logic

facebookresearch_meshrcnn/meshrcnn/utils.draw_text_on_image: draw text with a green background label on a BGR image at a given position
facebookresearch_meshrcnn/meshrcnn/utils.draw_boxes_on_image: draw green bounding boxes on a BGR image from a Boxes object or numpy array
facebookresearch_meshrcnn/meshrcnn/utils.draw_mask_on_image: overlay a colored segmentation mask with optional contours on a BGR image
facebookresearch_meshrcnn/meshrcnn/utils.print_class_histogram: print a tabulated histogram of per-class instance counts and box, mask, and mesh AP scores
facebookresearch_meshrcnn/meshrcnn/utils.visualize_predictions: visualize detection predictions by saving overlayed mask images and OBJ mesh files to disk
